mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an active monetary easing policy, which reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over the prior month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.5%), or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) over the prior month signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (both INDPRO and HOUST declining) fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 220, it indicates a high inflation regime that typically triggers aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior month signals strong consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 60% of instances when RSAFS increases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the unemployment rate below 4.5% over the prior month indicates a tight labor market that typically leads to inflationary pressures and subsequent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 4.5%), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) over the prior month signals a broad-based economic contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (both PAYEMS and HOUST declining) fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime defined by declining industrial production (INDPRO) and rising unemployment (UNRATE), the S&P 500 typically experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when the recessionary regime (INDPRO decline and UNRATE rise) is active, or the Rank IC for the regime signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year window.
